title: Fix the Mistyped Constructor
description: The program should create a Car object with a model attribute set in the constructor. Fix the bug.
actualProblem: The constructor is named __int__ instead of __init__ (a one-letter typo). Python never recognizes it as the special constructor method, so self.model is never set, and accessing c.model raises an AttributeError.
explanation: Python calls the exact method named __init__ automatically when an object is created. Because __int__ is a different (unrelated) method name, it's simply never invoked, silently leaving the object's attributes unset.
